items.title: 〈能源盤後〉美伊再交火！Brent周漲7.6% WTI飆近10% 美國柴油創歷史新高
items.title_en: After-Hours Energy: US and Iran Clash Again! Brent Up 7.6% Weekly, WTI Near 10% Surge, US Diesel Hits Record High
paras: 美國與伊朗軍事衝突再度升溫，國際油價周五(4日)收高，並以大幅周線漲幅作收。布蘭特原油期貨上漲76美分或0.8%，收在每桶92.68美元；美國西德州中級原油(WTI)期貨上漲18美分或0.20%，收在91.48美元。累計本周，布蘭特原油上漲7.6%，美國原油漲幅接近10%，創下7月中旬以來最強勁的單周表現之一。
油價上揚之際，美國柴油價格更創下歷史新高。美國汽車協會(AAA)數據顯示，截至9月4日，全美柴油平均零售價格升至每加侖5.85美元，突破2022年俄烏戰爭爆發後創下的前高；與一周前的5.61美元相比，漲幅約4.3%，較一年前的3.71美元則高出約58%。同期全美普通汽油平均價格也升至每加侖4.15美元左右。
柴油價格飆升對美國經濟的影響尤其廣泛，因為柴油是貨運、農業、建築及物流業的重要能源。隨著美國部分農業州進入收成及播種季節，農業機具對柴油的需求增加，而柴油庫存持續下降，市場人士預期價格仍可能進一步上升。取暖油期貨近期也同步大漲，隨著冬季接近，燃料市場壓力進一步擴大。
Rystad Energy首席經濟學家Claudio Galimberti表示，柴油涉及經濟各個產業，因此燃料價格持續上漲也會加劇通膨壓力，並推升美國政府債券殖利率。由於市場預期通膨可能持續升高，利率及政府融資成本也可能受到牽動。
此次油價上漲的核心仍是美伊衝突。美國與伊朗本周恢復軍事交火，成為兩國自7月以來最激烈的一輪衝突。美國持續打擊伊朗軍事及能源相關目標，伊朗則進行反擊，市場因此擔心中東原油供應及運輸路線進一步受阻。
荷姆茲海峽仍是市場最大的風險來源之一。雖然美國政府表示，中東石油運輸近期已恢復至接近正常水平，但航運追蹤資料顯示，實際船舶通行量仍遠低於正常水準。初步數據顯示，周四僅有4艘商品運輸船通過荷姆茲海峽，遠低於約15艘的10日平均水平。
Julius Baer經濟及次世代研究主管Norbert Rucker表示，油市目前似乎已進入一種「衝突僵局與反覆敵對行動不斷喚醒油價風險溢價」的階段。不過，他指出，目前沒有跡象顯示本周衝突升級已對中東石油出口造成實質重大影響，因此近期油價上漲更多反映市場情緒及恐懼，而非實際供應量突然大幅下降。
然而，供應路線受阻仍讓交易商不敢低估地緣政治風險。荷姆茲海峽是全球最重要的能源運輸通道之一，任何長時間的航運中斷，都可能使原油、成品油及液化天然氣供應受到衝擊，並將高油價迅速傳導至運輸、農業、製造及消費市場。
除了中東供應風險外，烏克蘭近期對俄羅斯煉油設施發動攻擊，也進一步收緊全球成品油供應。美俄烏戰事造成的煉油能力受損，加上美伊衝突同時干擾中東能源運輸，使柴油市場面臨原油及煉製產品雙重供應壓力。
柴油價格的急升也可能擴大通膨的廣度。美國貨運業大量依賴柴油，農業機具同樣以柴油為主要燃料，因此燃料成本上升將提高食品、物流及各類商品的運輸成本。FedEx及UPS等大型物流業者已透過燃油附加費因應成本壓力，而小型企業承受的衝擊可能更為明顯。
市場同時重新調高油價預期。花旗將第3季布蘭特原油平均價格預測從每桶80美元上調至86美元，理由是荷姆茲海峽重新開放所需時間長於原先預期。ANZ分析師則把短期布蘭特原油價格預測上調至95美元，並警告如果中東衝突進一步升級，油價仍存在上行風險。
油價後市同時受到美國貨幣政策牽動。美國8月新增非農就業人數達16.2萬人，顯示勞動市場仍具韌性，也降低市場對經濟急速轉弱的擔憂，但另一方面可能強化聯準會在9月維持甚至提高利率的理由。Again Capital合夥人John Kilduff表示，強勁的就業數據指向聯準會升息可能性，這對WTI形成壓力。
換言之，目前油市面臨兩股相反力量。一方面，美伊軍事衝突、荷姆茲海峽運輸受阻及俄羅斯煉油設施遭襲，持續推升原油及燃料的地緣政治風險溢價；另一方面，美國就業市場仍有韌性，若通膨重新升溫，聯準會可能維持較緊縮的貨幣政策，進而限制油價漲幅。
供應面也出現部分緩衝。伊拉克8月石油出口量已升至約每日234萬桶，遠高於7月約每日135萬桶。伊拉克能源官員表示，出口增加有助於抵銷部分中東其他地區供應受阻的影響。
不過，市場仍須關注伊朗石油出口遭到封鎖及制裁後的變化。3名伊朗官員表示，美國試圖透過封鎖伊朗石油出口及阻止制裁規避行為來削弱伊朗經濟，但隨著衝突延長，相關措施也越來越難維持。若伊朗進一步採取措施限制能源運輸，油市風險溢價可能再次快速擴大。
目前的關鍵變數仍是荷姆茲海峽能否恢復穩定通航，以及美伊雙方是否會停止新一輪軍事攻擊。若衝突持續，油價可能朝95美元甚至更高水準測試；反之，若航運恢復正常且地緣政治緊張程度下降，近期因恐慌情緒累積的風險溢價也可能快速回吐。
paras_en: U.S. and Iran’s military clash heated up again, sending international oil prices higher on Friday (the 4th) and closing with a large weekly gain. Brent crude futures rose 76 cents, or 0.8%, to $92.68 a barrel; U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) futures rose 18 cents, or 0.20%, to $91.48. Over the week, Brent gained 7.6% and U.S. crude rose close to 10%, marking one of the strongest weekly performances since mid‑July.

While oil prices were climbing, U.S. diesel hit a historic high. Data from the American Automobile Association (AAA) show that as of September 4, the national average retail diesel price rose to $5.85 per gallon, surpassing the post‑Russia‑Ukraine war peak set in 2022; that’s about a 4.3% increase from a week earlier’s $5.61 and roughly 58% above the $3.71 level a year ago. At the same time, the average U.S. regular gasoline price also climbed to around $4.15 per gallon.

The diesel price surge has far‑reaching effects on the U.S. economy because diesel fuels freight, agriculture, construction and logistics. With several agricultural states entering harvest and planting seasons, demand for diesel by farm equipment is rising while inventories keep falling, leading market participants to expect further price gains. Heating‑oil futures have also jumped recently, adding pressure to fuel markets as winter approaches.

Rystad Energy chief economist Claudio Galimberti said diesel touches every sector of the economy, so continued fuel‑price increases will intensify inflationary pressure and push up U.S. government‑bond yields. Because markets anticipate inflation could stay elevated, interest rates and sovereign‑financing costs may also be affected.

The core driver of the price rise remains the U.S.–Iran conflict. The two countries resumed military exchanges this week, marking the most intense round of fighting since July. The U.S. continued striking Iranian military and energy‑related targets, while Iran retaliated, prompting worries that Middle‑East crude supply and transport routes could face further disruptions.

The Hormuz Strait remains one of the market’s biggest risk sources. Although the U.S. government says Middle‑East oil shipments have returned to near‑normal levels, vessel‑tracking data show actual traffic is still far below normal. Preliminary figures indicate only four commercial vessels passed through Hormuz on Thursday, well under the roughly 15‑ship ten‑day average.

Julius Baer head of economics and next‑generation research Norbert Rucker said the oil market now seems to be in a “conflict stalemate with recurring hostile actions constantly reviving a risk premium” phase. However, he noted there is no sign that this week’s escalation has materially impacted Middle‑East oil exports, so the recent price rise reflects market sentiment and fear more than a sudden, large supply drop.

Nevertheless, traders remain wary of geopolitical risk. Hormuz is one of the world’s most important energy corridors, and any prolonged shipping interruption could hit crude, refined products and LNG supplies, quickly transmitting high oil prices to transport, agriculture, manufacturing and consumer markets.

Beyond Middle‑East supply worries, Ukraine’s recent attacks on Russian refining facilities have further tightened global refined‑product supplies. Damage to refining capacity from the Russia‑Ukraine war, combined with the U.S.–Iran clash disrupting Middle‑East energy flows, puts the diesel market under dual pressure from crude and refined‑product shortages.

The sharp diesel price jump could also broaden inflation’s reach. U.S. freight relies heavily on diesel, and farm equipment also runs on diesel, so higher fuel costs will raise transportation costs for food, logistics and a wide range of goods. Large carriers such as FedEx and UPS have already added fuel surcharges, while smaller firms may feel the impact even more acutely.

Markets have also revised oil‑price expectations upward. Citi lifted its Q3 Brent average forecast from $80 to $86 a barrel, citing a longer‑than‑expected reopening of Hormuz. ANZ analysts raised their short‑term Brent target to $95 and warned that further escalation in the Middle East could keep upside risk alive.

Oil‑price outlook is also tied to U.S. monetary policy. August added 162,000 non‑farm jobs, showing labor‑market resilience and easing fears of a rapid economic slowdown, but also bolstering the case for the Fed to keep or raise rates in September. Again Capital partner John Kilduff said the strong jobs data points to a higher likelihood of a rate hike, which puts pressure on WTI.

In other words, the oil market now faces two opposing forces. On one side, the U.S.–Iran military clash, Hormuz shipping disruptions and attacks on Russian refineries keep lifting the geopolitical risk premium on crude and fuels; on the other, a resilient U.S. labor market could prompt tighter monetary policy if inflation revives, curbing price gains.

Supply‑side cushioning is also emerging. Iraq’s August oil exports rose to about 2.34 million barrels per day, far above July’s roughly 1.35 million barrels. Iraqi energy officials said the higher exports help offset some of the supply constraints elsewhere in the Middle East.

However, markets must still watch how Iranian oil exports evolve after blockades and sanctions. Three Iranian officials said the U.S. is trying to weaken Iran’s economy by blocking its oil exports and preventing sanction‑evasion, but as the conflict drags on those measures become harder to sustain. If Iran further restricts energy shipments, the oil‑market risk premium could expand rapidly again.

The key variables remain whether Hormuz can return to stable navigation and whether the U.S. and Iran will cease the latest round of attacks. If the conflict persists, oil could test $95 or higher; conversely, if shipping normalizes and geopolitical tension eases, the panic‑driven risk premium may quickly unwind.

items.title: 中國稀土企業暫停對美出口 消息人士揭原因
items.title_en: Chinese Rare Earth Companies Halt Exports to the U.S., Sources Reveal Reasons
paras: 《路透》引述3名消息人士報導，部分中國稀土供應商因擔心遭北京方面懲處，近期拒絕向美國企業出貨。隨著中國國家主席習近平預計9月24日訪問華盛頓，美國能否穩定取得稀土等關鍵材料，已被納入美方會前議程籌備工作。
美國官員過去多次要求中國履行一年來在南韓釜山及北京作出的承諾，確保稀土出口許可證順利核發。一名熟悉相關工作的人士表示，由於供應問題持續存在，美方正準備在習近平訪美前處理此項議題。
一名直接了解情況的消息人士指出，中國8月初制裁美國供應鏈監督組織「負責任商業聯盟」(Responsible Business Alliance，RBA) 後，已有少數中國供應商拒絕向美國企業出口稀土。
另外兩名知情人士透露，近幾個月還有其他中國稀土企業為避免捲入地緣政治爭端，選擇停止對美供貨。其中一名消息人士舉例指出，有中國業者擔心相關材料可能被轉售給遭禁止供貨的用戶，因此拒絕出貨。
一名不具名美國官員表示，華府將持續敦促北京處理美方所稱未落實釜山協議承諾的問題，以及其他雙邊關切事項。
稀土廣泛用於戰機、潛艦、無人機、飛彈、雷達及精準導引武器。
Sprott Asset Management報告指出，中國以外地區目前每年僅生產約2萬至2.5萬噸稀土磁鐵，全球產量約25萬噸。國際能源署(IEA) 數據顯示，中國雖占全球稀土礦產供應60%，卻掌握91%的相關精煉產能及94%的永久磁鐵製造能力。
2022年，一具F-35引擎磁鐵被發現含有中國來源合金，導致新機交付一度暫停；中國2025年又對多種重稀土及相關磁鐵實施出口管制，進一步暴露美國國防供應鏈的弱點。
美國國防部對特殊稀土磁鐵的需求預計到2030年增至每年1萬噸，約為目前的3倍，更相當於現階段中國以外產量近半，凸顯華府建立獨立國防供應鏈的難度。
華府目前透過價格保障、包銷及融資扶植本土產業。
五角大廈去年與MP Materials(MP-US) 簽署協議，為其釹鐠產品提供每公斤110美元的10年價格下限，並承諾為規劃中的10X工廠全部磁鐵產量提供10年買家保障。該公司將在德州興建投資逾12.5億美元的一體化生產園區。
Energy Fuels(UUUU-US) 取得最高7.25億美元美國政府附條件支持，用於擴建猶他州稀土分離及下游產能；USA Rare Earth(USAR-US) 則獲得近16億美元資金及貸款，規劃把美國磁鐵年產能提升至1萬噸。華府另參與巴西Serra Verde礦場規模15.5億美元的融資方案，以擴大上游原料來源。
Sprott資深投資組合經理Justin Tolman表示，美國政策正從補助個別稀土項目，轉向協助整條本土供應鏈建立可行商業模式。不過，單純開發新礦場仍不足以解決問題，若礦物必須送往中國加工或製成磁鐵，供應安全依舊無法獲得保障。
paras_en: Reuters, citing three sources, reported that some Chinese rare‑earth suppliers have recently refused shipments to U.S. firms out of fear of punishment from Beijing. With Chinese President Xi Jinping slated to visit Washington on Sept. 24, the United States is preparing to address the stability of rare‑earth and other critical material supplies in its pre‑visit agenda.

U.S. officials have repeatedly urged China to honor commitments made in Busan, South Korea and Beijing over the past year to ensure smooth issuance of rare‑earth export licences. A person familiar with the matter said that because supply problems persist, Washington is getting ready to tackle the issue before Xi’s U.S. visit.

A source with direct knowledge said that after China sanctioned the U.S. supply‑chain oversight group Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) in early August, a handful of Chinese suppliers have already refused to export rare earths to U.S. companies.

Two other informed sources added that in recent months additional Chinese rare‑earth firms have chosen to stop U.S. shipments to avoid being caught up in geopolitical disputes. One source cited an example of a Chinese company that feared its materials could be resold to prohibited end‑users, so it declined to ship them.
An unnamed U.S. official said Washington will continue to press Beijing on what it calls China’s failure to fulfill the Busan agreement commitments and other bilateral concerns.
Rare earths are widely used in fighter jets, submarines, drones, missiles, radar and precision‑guided weapons.

A Sprott Asset Management report notes that outside China only about 20,000‑25,000 tonnes of rare‑earth magnets are produced annually, compared with roughly 250,000 tonnes worldwide. IEA data show that while China supplies 60% of global rare‑earth ore, it controls 91% of downstream refining capacity and 94% of permanent‑magnet manufacturing capability.

In 2022 a magnet for an F‑35 engine was found to contain Chinese‑origin alloy, temporarily halting new aircraft deliveries; China’s 2025 export controls on several heavy rare earths and related magnets further exposed vulnerabilities in the U.S. defense supply chain.

The U.S. Department of Defense projects demand for special‑rare‑earth magnets to rise to 10,000 tonnes per year by 2030 – about three times current levels and roughly half of non‑Chinese production today – underscoring the difficulty of building an independent defense supply chain.
Washington is currently supporting domestic production through price guarantees, off‑take agreements and financing incentives.

Last year the Pentagon signed a deal with MP Materials (MP‑US) to provide a ten‑year price floor of $110 per kilogram for its neodymium‑iron‑boron product and to guarantee purchase of all magnet output from the planned “10X” plant. The company will build an integrated production complex in Texas costing more than $1.25 billion.

Energy Fuels (UUUU‑US) secured up to $725 million in conditional U.S. government support to expand rare‑earth separation and downstream capacity in Utah, while USA Rare Earth (USAR‑US) received nearly $1.6 billion in funding and loans to raise U.S. magnet capacity to 10,000 tonnes per year. Washington is also participating in a $1.55 billion financing package for Brazil’s Serra Verde mine to broaden upstream raw‑material sources.

Sprott senior portfolio manager Justin Tolman said U.S. policy is shifting from subsidising individual rare‑earth projects to helping build a viable commercial model for an entire domestic supply chain. However, simply developing new mines is insufficient; if minerals still have to be processed or turned into magnets in China, supply security will remain unguaranteed.

items.title: 海景第一排！南山人壽斥資逾40億元 淡水沙崙打造首座永續教育人才基地
items.title_en: Prime Sea View! Nanshan Life Invests Over NT$4 Billion to Build Taiwan's First Sustainable Education Talent Hub in Tamsui's Shalun
paras: 南山人壽積極深耕台灣人才培育與永續發展，首度公開位於新北市淡水的「沙崙文創園區」。該案為南山人壽投資的50年地上權案，基地面積達3.7公頃、建築總面積約9,000坪，總投資金額超過新台幣40億元。園區坐落於淡水海岸，被譽為「海景第一排」的教育訓練中心，不僅是南山人壽培訓內外勤人才的新重鎮，更結合永續發展與海洋保育，成為全台首座開放與在地居民共享的永續教育基地。
南山人壽總經理范文偉表示，面對未來日益競爭的金融環境，提升訓練的質與量勢在必行。園區整體分為兩期規劃，第一期教育訓練基地規劃8間多功能培訓教室及1間可容納900人的大型展演廳，合計9間空間可同時容納近2,000人，預計於今年9月底正式啟用，目前預約相當踴躍，年底前的使用率已高達48%。
第二期則為住宿與營運配套設施，位於園區對面，規劃有77間高品質住宿房間、餐廳及267個停車位，預計於2027年第三季正式投入營運，未來可提供員工進行2天1夜的深度體驗訓練。
談及建置初衷，范文偉指出，傳統辦公室教室空間有限，沙崙園區希望能結合戶外綠地、海景與藝術文化，讓同仁在敞開窗戶面對大海的環境中學習，激發創意與多元思維。
園區在興建過程中極力保護在地生態與歷史遺蹟，保留當地的安山岩(火山岩)自然景觀與黃瑾木走道，並一舉榮獲綠建築標章、智慧建築、WELL健康建築、LEED認證、建築能效標章及耐震標章等7項國內外認證。此外，園區完全開放不設阻隔，擁有3,000坪開放親水綠地且可直通沙灘，未來將舉辦假日市集、手作體驗、親子活動與在地文化導覽，讓鄰里居民與保戶共同享用這片永續空間。
南山人壽永續健康長陳維新表示，南山人壽長期投入海洋保育，15年來已號召逾5萬人次淨灘、清理88公噸海廢。園區內特別設立「南山海洋共學方舟」，推出常設展與特展「一片海廢的旅程」。
在跨界合作策展方面，透過文策院媒合，與創意團隊「半隻羊」合作，將廢棄寶特瓶蓋、牛奶瓶身、醫療廢棄物及舊漁網再製成大型海生箱與海廢藝術牆。同時導入AR擴增實境與NFC感應卡，讓觀展者化身為海廢角色，切身體會海洋垃圾對生態的影響。
范文偉轉述董事長尹崇堯經營理念，「必須要深耕台灣、投資在地人才。」南山人壽目前擁有約4,400名內勤與3.3萬名外勤業務大軍，其中北部人力占近五成。
南山正積極串聯全台，建構完整的多核心人才培育網絡。北部包括淡水沙崙文創園區、宜蘭訓練中心，以及預計今年9月下旬正式啟用的「桃園金融廣場」，將整合桃竹苗內外勤單位並設全新訓練空間。
中區則有台中干城大樓、烏日訓練中心。南區為台南廣場，以及已承租高雄「義享大樓」約5,000坪辦公空間，預計明年第四季完成裝修進駐，作為南區營運與培訓重鎮。
南山人壽期許透過沙崙園區的啟用，將保險業務從「事後理賠」延伸至「健康預防與永續源頭防治」，以金融圈最高規格的訓練空間與品質，為台灣的人才培育與海洋永續注入新動能。
paras_en: Nanshan Life is actively deepening its commitment to talent development and sustainable growth in Taiwan, unveiling for the first time its "Shalun Cultural and Creative Park" in Tamsui, New Taipei City. The project is a 50‑year ground‑rights investment by Nanshan Life, covering 3.7 hectares with a total built area of about 9,000 ping, and a total investment exceeding NT$4 billion. Situated on the Tamsui coastline and hailed as a "front‑row sea‑view" education and training centre, it will serve as a new hub for training both internal and field staff, while integrating sustainability and marine conservation to become the nation’s first open, community‑shared sustainable education base.

Nanshan Life General Manager Fan Wen‑wei said that in the face of an increasingly competitive financial environment, enhancing both the quality and quantity of training is essential. The park is planned in two phases; Phase 1, the education‑training base, will feature eight multifunctional classrooms and a large performance hall that seats 900, totaling nine spaces that can accommodate nearly 2,000 people simultaneously. It is slated to open at the end of September this year, with strong booking demand and an anticipated utilization rate of 48% by year‑end.

Phase 2 will provide accommodation and operational facilities opposite the main campus, comprising 77 high‑quality guest rooms, a restaurant and 267 parking spaces. It is expected to commence operations in the third quarter of 2027, enabling staff to undertake two‑day, one‑night intensive training experiences.

Speaking of the project's origin, Fan explained that traditional office classrooms are limited in space, and the Shalun park aims to blend outdoor green areas, sea views and artistic culture so that employees can learn with the ocean beyond open windows, sparking creativity and diverse thinking.

During construction, the park has strived to protect local ecology and historic sites, preserving the area’s andesite volcanic rock landscape and the Huang Jin‑mu walkway. It has earned seven domestic and international certifications, including Green Building label, Smart Building, WELL health building, LEED, energy‑efficiency, seismic and others. The park is fully open without barriers, offering 3,000 ping of waterfront green space that leads directly to the beach, and will host weekend markets, craft workshops, family activities and local cultural tours for nearby residents and policyholders alike.

Nanshan Life’s Sustainable Health Director Chen Wei‑hsin noted that the company has long invested in marine conservation, mobilising over 50,000 volunteers in the past 15 years to conduct beach clean‑ups and remove 88 tonnes of marine waste. The park features a dedicated "Nanshan Ocean Co‑learning Ark" with a permanent exhibition and a special show titled "Journey of a Piece of Marine Debris".

In cross‑industry curatorial collaborations, the Cultural and Creative Agency matched Nanshan Life with the creative team "Half a Sheep" to transform discarded PET caps, milk bottle bodies, medical waste and old fishing nets into a large marine‑life installation and an ocean‑debris art wall. Augmented‑reality (AR) and NFC cards are incorporated, allowing visitors to assume the role of marine debris and experience firsthand the ecological impact of ocean litter.

Fan relayed Chairman Yin Chong‑yao’s philosophy: "We must deeply cultivate Taiwan and invest in local talent." Nanshan Life currently employs about 4,400 office staff and 33,000 field agents, with nearly half of the workforce based in the north.

Nanshan is actively linking sites across Taiwan to build a comprehensive multi‑core talent‑development network. In the north, this includes the Tamsui Shalun Cultural and Creative Park, the Yilan Training Center, and the "Taoyuan Financial Plaza" slated to open in late September, which will integrate internal and field units from Taoyuan, Hsinchu and Miaoli into a brand‑new training space.

The central region hosts the Taichung Gan‑cheng Building and the Wuri Training Center, while the south features the Tainan Plaza and a leased 5,000‑ping office space in Kaohsiung’s "Yi‑Xiang Building," slated for completion and move‑in in the fourth quarter of next year, becoming the southern hub for operations and training.

Nanshan Life hopes that the opening of the Shalun park will extend insurance services from "post‑claim" to "health prevention and sustainable source control," injecting new momentum into Taiwan’s talent cultivation and marine sustainability with the highest‑standard training facilities and quality in the financial sector.

items.title: 〈台幣〉熱錢回流強升1.25角收31.63元 周線仍翻黑中止連5升
items.title_en: TWD: Hot‑money inflow drives a strong 0.125‑point rise to 31.63; weekly chart turns red, halting five‑week gains
paras: 美國聯準會官員放鴿，台北股匯今(4)日連袂展開反攻，在熱錢回流下，新台幣兌美元匯率中止連二貶走勢，終場強升1.25角，收在31.63元，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值 25.925 億美元。
本周外資偏向匯出，新台幣匯率先貶後升，累計小貶 0.2 分，周線翻黑，中止連續 5 周的升值走勢。
在美股回神激勵下，台股今天展開反彈，聯發科、國巨*等權值股領軍走強，大盤終場上漲693.47點，收在46551.13點，站回5日線。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為31.72元，最高升抵 31.627 元，終場收在31.63元、強彈1.25角。
近期日圓升值主要受美日官方聯合干預匯市、日本央行升息預期升溫以及套利交易(Carry Trade)大量平倉所致，已從日前的 160 兌 1 美元一路升到 155 價位。
觀察主要亞幣今天表現，根據央行統計，日元強升0.48%，新台幣升值 0.40%，韓元升值 0.33%，星幣升值 0.16%，人民幣升值 0.1%，亞幣整體偏升。
paras_en: U.S. Federal Reserve officials took a dovish stance, and Taipei's stock and foreign‑exchange markets launched a counter‑attack today (4th). With hot‑money inflows, the New Taiwan dollar against the US dollar halted its two‑session depreciation trend, jumping 0.125 NTD to close at 31.63, while total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange market reached US$2.5925 billion.

This week foreign investors tended toward net outflows; the TWD first depreciated then appreciated, resulting in a cumulative small depreciation of 0.2 points. The weekly chart turned red, ending a five‑week appreciation streak.

Boosted by a rebound in U.S. equities, the Taiwan stock market rallied today, with heavyweight stocks such as MediaTek and Yageo leading the gains. The index closed up 693.47 points at 46,551.13, back above its 5‑day moving average.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.72 per US$, peaked at 31.627, and closed at 31.63, a strong bounce of 0.125 NTD.

The recent appreciation of the Japanese yen is mainly due to coordinated intervention by U.S. and Japanese authorities, rising expectations of Bank of Japan rate hikes, and massive unwindings of carry‑trade positions, moving from around 160 yen per dollar to about 155 yen.

Looking at the performance of major Asian currencies today, according to central‑bank data, the yen strengthened by 0.48%, the TWD by 0.40%, the won by 0.33%, the Singapore dollar by 0.16%, the renminbi by 0.10%; overall Asian currencies were on the upside.

items.title: 台灣8月外匯存底重返6000億美元關 終結連2減 增額創16個月來最大
items.title_en: Taiwan's August Foreign Exchange Reserves Rebound to $600.19 B, Ending Two‑Month Decline and Marking the Largest Increase in 16 Months
paras: 台灣央行今(6)日公布我國8月底外匯存底，較上月底增加76.33億美元至6019.04億美元，終結連2月下滑，並創去年5月以來最大增額，而外資持有國內股票及債券按當日市價計算，連同其新台幣存款餘額共折計1兆8610億美元，約當外匯存底309%。
央行外匯局局長蔡烱民說明，8月外匯存底增加主因外匯存底投資運用收益、主要貨幣對美元匯率變動，以及央行為維持外匯市場秩序進場調節。
央行統計，多數非美貨幣升值，其中，加幣升值0.91%、歐元升值0.68%、日元升值0.49%、人民幣升值0.35%，而新台幣更強升達2.51%。
蔡烱民進一步指出，8月雖有外資領股利後匯出因素，但整體淨匯入12億美元，使8月底外資持有國內股票及債券按當日市價計算，連同其新台幣存款餘額回升至1兆8610億美元，約當外匯存底309%。
觀察主要國家外匯存底變化，中國為3兆4188億美元，日本1兆896億美元，瑞士為9458億美元，香港4353億美元，南韓為4174億美元，印度為5913億美元。
paras_en: The Central Bank of Taiwan announced today (the 6th) that the country's foreign exchange reserves at the end of August rose by $7.633 billion to $601.904 billion, ending a two‑month drop and representing the biggest monthly increase since May last year. Including foreign investors' holdings of domestic stocks and bonds valued at market prices on the same day, together with their New Taiwan dollar deposits, the total foreign‑owned assets amount to $1.861 trillion, roughly 309% of the foreign exchange reserves.

Central Bank Foreign Exchange Bureau Director Cai Jiong‑min explained that the August rise in reserves was mainly due to earnings from reserve investments, exchange‑rate movements of major currencies against the U.S. dollar, and the central bank’s market‑stabilisation interventions.

The bank’s data show that most non‑U.S. currencies appreciated: the Canadian dollar rose 0.91%, the euro 0.68%, the yen 0.49%, and the Chinese renminbi 0.35%, while the New Taiwan dollar strengthened even more, gaining 2.51%.

Cai added that although August saw some outflows from foreign investors repatriating dividend payments, net inflows were still $1.2 billion, bringing the market‑value of foreign‑held domestic stocks and bonds, together with their New Taiwan dollar deposits, back up to $1.861 trillion – about 309% of the foreign exchange reserves.

Looking at the foreign‑exchange reserve levels of major economies, China holds $3.4188 trillion, Japan $1.0896 trillion, Switzerland $945.8 billion, Hong Kong $435.3 billion, South Korea $417.4 billion, and India $591.3 billion.

items.title: 7月獲利亮眼 外資買超助華星光、前鼎收漲停
items.title_en: July Profits Shine as Foreign Buying Drives Hua Xing Guang and Qian Ding to Limit‑Up
paras: 摩根士丹利(大摩)近期發布報告，預測微軟、Google母公司Alphabet、亞馬遜、Meta這四家超大規模雲端業者資本支出，將從今(2026)年到明(2027)年再增加57％，台廠供應鏈預期有望受惠，今(4)日包括華星光(4979-TW)、前鼎(4908-TW)在外資挹注下，雙雙收漲停板。
觀察盤後證交所提供資訊，外資連6買華星光，本周收629元，周K連收5紅；前鼎則是由賣轉買，收224.5元，股價站上所有均線，周K連收2紅。
華星光因受惠AI高速光通訊需求升溫，自結7月獲利走強，稅後純益1.31億元、年增逾6成、EPS為0.92元，較去年同期0.56元提升。
前鼎自結7月單月獲利為2,400萬元、年增達140%，單月每股純益為0.31元。
法人表示，華星光800G ZR模組於今年第3季進入量產，出貨單價約為400G模組的數倍，加上CW Laser與EML雙產品線同步擴產，營運動能明確轉強。法人預估公司2026年全年營收有望年增38%。
前鼎則受惠市場對AI資料中心與高速光通訊模組的需求期待，公司看好光源模組外置將成CPO架構主流趨勢，標準型產品則鎖定800G與1.6T交換機應用，將在完成客戶驗證後進入量產。
法人指出，隨著AI基建軍備競賽持續升溫，全球四大雲端服務供應商(CSP)在今年資本支出合計上看7,250億美元，其中亞馬遜(AMZN-US)更預計將砸2,000億美元擴建AWS雲端基礎設施，有望視為台廠供應鏈一大利多。
paras_en: Morgan Stanley recently released a report forecasting that the capital expenditures of the four mega cloud providers—Microsoft, Alphabet (Google’s parent), Amazon and Meta—will increase by 57% from this year (2026) to next year (2027). Taiwan’s semiconductor supply chain is expected to benefit, and on the 4th, both Hua Xing Guang (4979‑TW) and Qian Ding (4908‑TW) hit limit‑up on foreign inflows.

Observing post‑market data from the Taiwan Stock Exchange, foreign investors bought Hua Xing Guang for six consecutive sessions, closing at NT$629 this week with five straight red candles on the weekly chart. Qian Ding switched from net selling to buying, closing at NT$224.5, its price above all moving averages and two consecutive weekly reds.

Hua Xing Guang, buoyed by rising demand for high‑speed AI optical communications, reported strong July earnings with a post‑tax net profit of NT$131 million, up more than 60% year‑over‑year, and an EPS of NT$0.92 versus NT$0.56 a year earlier.
Qian Ding posted a July net profit of NT$24 million for the month, a 140% year‑over‑year increase, translating to a monthly EPS of NT$0.31.

Institutional investors noted that Hua Xing Guang’s 800G ZR module entered mass production in Q3 of this year, with a unit price several times that of the 400G module. Combined with simultaneous capacity expansions in its CW Laser and EML product lines, the company’s operating momentum is clearly strengthening. They project a 38% year‑over‑year revenue growth for 2026.

Qian Ding benefits from market expectations for AI data‑center and high‑speed optical‑communication modules. The company sees externalized light‑source modules becoming the mainstream trend in CPO architectures, and its standard products target 800G and 1.6T switch applications, which will move to mass production after customer validation.

Institutions pointed out that as the AI infrastructure arms race heats up, the four global cloud service providers are expected to spend a total of $725 billion on capex this year, with Amazon (AMZN‑US) alone planning to invest $200 billion to expand AWS infrastructure—an obvious tailwind for Taiwan’s supply chain.

items.title: 海悅新建案交屋陸續發酵  8月營收14.25億元年增5.4倍
items.title_en: Haiyue's New Projects Handover Gains Momentum; August Revenue Reaches NT$1.425 Billion, Up 5.4‑fold YoY
paras: 全台房產代銷龍頭海悅(2348-TW)今(4)日公布最新營收資訊，2026年8月營收14.25億元，月減31.4%，年增5.4倍，累計1-8月營收66.19億元，年增率80.61%。預估海悅在起6月啟動台北「敦仰」等案交屋後，2026年下半年業績表現估將優於上半年。
海悅8月代銷業績持續穩健，包含 :新北市中和區「寶亞世界公舘」、「大同新紀元」、永和區「漢皇River Sky」、新莊及台南等建案開案銷況符合預期，加上台北市、新北市及新竹等多項指標建案即將公開銷售，只要符合消費者預期且買得起的房價個案，預售建案成交量可期，公司於銷售業績逐步反映，後續持續貢獻營收表現。
海悅6月啟動台北「敦仰」、新北「A 3光點」與高雄「達麗未來市」三項建案完工交屋認列，並持續挹注7、8月營收表現，且8月再啟動「微笑海悅2」與「台灣隱賦」完工交屋認列，為8月營建收入再添成長動能。
海悅下半年營運估將優於上半年，主要公司維持每年均有投資收益建案挹注代銷與營建收入，多角化經營擴張營運版圖；今年公司已啟動5項投資收益建案，年底前尚有台中市北區「達麗冶翠」案入帳，海悅透過垂直整合優勢，參與建商前期產品規劃，營運加速鞏固並擴大市占率。
paras_en: Taiwan's leading property brokerage Haiyue (2348‑TW) announced today that its August 2026 revenue was NT$1.425 billion, down 31.4% month‑over‑month but up 5.4 times year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for January‑August reached NT$6.619 billion, an 80.61% increase from a year earlier. The company expects performance in the second half of 2026 to surpass the first half after the handover of projects such as Taipei’s “Dunyang” that began in June.

Haiyue’s August brokerage performance remained solid, with sales of projects including “Baoya World Plaza” and “Datong New Era” in Zhonghe, New Taipei, “Hanhuang River Sky” in Yonghe, as well as developments in Xinzhuang and Tainan meeting expectations. Several flagship projects in Taipei, New Taipei and Hsinchu are about to launch publicly; as long as prices match consumer expectations and affordability, pre‑sale volumes are expected to be strong, and the company’s sales results will gradually reflect this, continuing to boost revenue.

In June Haiyue began recognizing the completion and handover of three projects – Taipei’s “Dunyang”, New Taipei’s “A 3 Light Point” and Kaohsiung’s “Dali Future City” – which contributed to July and August revenue. In August it also started recognizing the handover of “Smile Haiyue 2” and “Taiwan Hidden Gift”, adding further growth momentum to construction income for the month.

Haiyue projects that its second‑half operations will outperform the first half, as the company consistently injects investment‑return projects into its brokerage and construction revenue each year, diversifying and expanding its operational footprint. This year it has launched five investment‑return projects, and before year‑end the “Dali Yecui” project in North Taichung is expected to be booked. Leveraging its vertical‑integration advantage, Haiyue participates in early‑stage product planning with developers, accelerating operations and solidifying and expanding its market share.

items.title: 每年2.7萬件受惠！台美專利電子交換今上線 加速供應鏈海外布局
items.title_en: 27,000 Cases Benefit Annually! Taiwan‑US Patent Electronic Exchange Goes Live Today, Accelerating Overseas Supply‑Chain Expansion
paras: 台美專利審查合作邁入新階段。智慧局今4日表示，於2023年11月22日我駐美國台北經濟文化代表處與美國在台協會完成簽署台美專利資料安全交換瞭解備忘錄後，智慧局與美國專利商標局雙方接續完成服務及對接資訊系統建構等籌備工作，台美專利優先權證明文件電子交換（PDX）自今（4）日起正式提供服務，為我國專利跨國審查合作啟動新的一頁。
智慧局說明，為提升跨國企業申請專利效率，各國專利主管機關無不致力於推動協力合作。自2013年起，我國已陸續與日本、韓國展開專利優先權證明文件電子交換，透過電子交換作業，簡化了兩國專利申請人主張國際優先權時須提出優先權證明文件之跨國申請程序，節省申請人提交紙本證明文件之時間及成本，亦有利於專利審查作業。

智慧局進一步說明，美國長期為我國人對外國申請專利最多的國家，每年申請件數約2萬件，另一方面，美國申請人每年向我國申請專利之件數約7千件，位居外國人在我國申請專利第2名。為進一步簡化台、美兩國申請人相互申請專利之手續，並持續拓展我國與各大專利局之審查合作，台、美兩國於2026年9月4日順利啟動專利優先權證明文件電子交換合作，日後經申請人聲明電子交換之案件，台、美兩局即可直接透過電子方式交換文件，大幅減少申請人負擔，提升我國國人向美國申請專利之便利性，亦有助美國來台申請專利，促進台美申請人雙贏。
業界指出，台美專利電子交換上線，可簡化跨國手續，大幅節省企業時間與成本。台灣具備豐沛的研發實力與高科技供應鏈，此舉不僅強化台灣全球發明樞紐的地位，更能讓半導體等核心高科技產業加快海外專利布局，顯著提升國際競爭力與智財防護網。
本次合作之各項作業說明，智慧局已公布台美專利優先權證明文件電子交換作業要點、作業說明及答客問，申請人可參見智慧局專利主題網優先權證明文件電子交換專區。
paras_en: Taiwan‑US patent examination cooperation has entered a new stage. The Intellectual Property Office announced on the 4th that after the Taipei Economic and Cultural Representative Office in the United States and the American Institute in Taiwan signed a memorandum of understanding on Taiwan‑US patent data security exchange on November 22, 2023, the Office and the United States Patent and Trademark Office have completed preparatory work on service and information‑system integration. The electronic exchange of Taiwan‑US patent priority documents (PDX) officially began service today (the 4th), marking a new chapter in cross‑border patent examination collaboration for Taiwan.

The Office explained that to improve patent‑application efficiency for multinational companies, patent authorities worldwide are working to promote cooperation. Since 2013, Taiwan has successively launched electronic exchanges of priority documents with Japan and South Korea. The electronic process simplifies the cross‑border filing procedure for applicants claiming international priority, saving time and costs associated with submitting paper documents and also benefiting patent examination work.

The Office further noted that the United States has long been the country to which Taiwanese applicants file the most foreign patents, with about 20,000 applications per year. Conversely, U.S. applicants file roughly 7,000 patents in Taiwan annually, ranking second among foreign filers. To further simplify the mutual filing procedures between Taiwan and the U.S. and to expand cooperation with major patent offices, Taiwan and the United States successfully launched the electronic exchange of priority documents on September 4, 2026. From now on, cases where applicants request electronic exchange will have documents transferred directly between the two offices, greatly reducing applicant burden, enhancing convenience for Taiwanese filing in the U.S., and aiding U.S. applicants in Taiwan, creating a win‑win for both sides.

Industry observers say the launch of the Taiwan‑US patent electronic exchange will streamline cross‑border procedures, saving companies substantial time and cost. Taiwan’s strong R&D capabilities and high‑tech supply chain mean this move not only reinforces Taiwan’s position as a global invention hub but also enables core high‑tech sectors such as semiconductors to accelerate overseas patent positioning, markedly boosting international competitiveness and intellectual‑property protection.

The Office has published the operational guidelines, detailed instructions and FAQs for the Taiwan‑US electronic exchange of priority documents. Applicants can refer to the Patent Priority Document Electronic Exchange section on the Intellectual Property Office’s patent portal for more information.

items.title: 布局直飲且新產能投入 鮮活果汁8月營收6.49億元攀頂 年增25%
items.title_en: Fresh Juice’s August Revenue Hits NT$649 million, Up 25% YoY as It Expands Direct‑Drink Offerings and New Capacity
paras: 2026年上半年稅後純益達3.21億元，年增1.18倍，每股純益8.98元的鮮活果汁-KY(1256-TW)今(4)日公布最新營收資訊，2026年8月營收6.49億元，創單月營收歷史新高，較上月增加4.77%，年增25.55%，累計1-8月合併營收39.16億元，年增率38.88%。
鮮活果汁-KY的8月業績成長並創新高，主要在正值行業傳統旺季，飲品市場需求持續暢旺，且公司優化產品結構，近年布局並逐步斬獲預包裝「直飲」市場商機，帶動直飲產品營收比重上升，成為公司新的營運成長動能，同時，鮮活果汁-KY昆山二期智能廠投產，新增年產能2萬噸。
鮮活果汁-KY昆山二期智能廠以大幅導入自動化生產設備、智慧倉儲及物流系統，透過智慧製造提升生產效率、品質穩定度及客製化能力，進一步強化整體供應鏈韌性，繳出連續6個月營收年、月雙增佳績。
鮮活果汁-KY持續深化智慧製造與物流整合，透過生產、倉儲及配送流程優化，打造「3-5天快速出貨」的供應服務優勢，提升對客戶需求的即時反應能力，並強化客製化、小批量及多元產品的供應彈性，進一步提升營運韌性。
鮮活果汁-KY加速掌握中國新茶飲產業精細化、多元化及健康化的發展趨勢，並結合智慧製造布局，持續提升整體營運效率與市場服務能力；公司亦積極開發多元產品及拓展經銷，深化既有市場並開拓新的成長動能，持續強化核心競爭力，穩健推升整體營運表現。
鮮活果汁-KY2026年第二季營收爲15.06億元，毛利率33.44%，季增3.05個百分點，年增2.89個百分點，單季稅後純益2.05億元，季增77.39%，年增68.07%，單季每股純益5.74元。同時，鮮活果汁-KY在2026年1-6月營收26.48億元，毛利率32.12%，年增4.27個百分點，稅後純益達3.21億元，年增1.18倍，每股純益8.98元。
paras_en: In the first half of 2026, Fresh Juice‑KY (1256‑TW) posted a post‑tax net profit of NT$321 million, a 1.18‑fold increase year‑over‑year, and earnings per share of NT$8.98. On August 4 it announced that August revenue reached NT$649 million, a record monthly high, up 4.77% from the prior month and 25.55% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for January‑August was NT$3.916 billion, up 38.88% YoY.

The August performance surge and new record were driven by the industry’s traditional peak season and sustained strong demand in the beverage market. The company has refined its product mix and, in recent years, has been positioning itself in the pre‑packaged “direct‑drink” market, raising the share of direct‑drink sales and creating a fresh growth engine. At the same time, Fresh Juice‑KY’s Phase II smart plant in Kunshan began operations, adding 20,000 tons of annual capacity.

The Kunshan Phase II smart plant heavily incorporates automated production equipment, intelligent warehousing, and logistics systems. Through smart manufacturing it boosts production efficiency, quality stability and customization capability, further strengthening overall supply‑chain resilience and delivering six consecutive months of double‑digit revenue growth both year‑over‑year and month‑over‑month.

Fresh Juice‑KY continues to deepen the integration of smart manufacturing and logistics, optimizing production, warehousing and distribution processes to create a “3‑5‑day fast‑shipping” service advantage. This enhances real‑time responsiveness to customer needs and reinforces flexibility for customized, small‑batch and diversified product supply, thereby improving operational resilience.

The company is accelerating its grasp of China’s emerging tea‑drink industry trends—greater refinement, diversification and health orientation—and combines these insights with its smart‑manufacturing strategy to continuously improve overall operational efficiency and market service capability. Fresh Juice‑KY is also actively developing a broader product portfolio and expanding distribution, deepening existing markets while opening new growth drivers, steadily strengthening its core competitiveness and boosting overall performance.

Fresh Juice‑KY’s Q2 2026 revenue was NT$1.506 billion, with a gross margin of 33.44%, up 3.05 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 2.89 points year‑over‑year. Quarterly post‑tax net profit reached NT$205 million, a 77.39% QoQ increase and 68.07% YoY increase, yielding earnings per share of NT$5.74. For the January‑June period, revenue totaled NT$2.648 billion, gross margin was 32.12% (up 4.27 points YoY), net profit hit NT$321 million (up 1.18‑fold YoY), and EPS was NT$8.98.

items.title: 大銀微系統8月營收寫單月最強年增近倍 營運邁高速成長期
items.title_en: DaYin Micro Systems' August Revenue Hits Record Monthly High with Near-Double Year‑over‑Year Growth, Entering a High‑Speed Growth Phase
paras: 大銀微系統(4576-TW)今(4)日公告 2026 年 8 月自結營收，受惠於半導體與矽光子強勁需求帶動，營收衝上 4.27 億元，創下史上單月新高，月增 16.35%，並較去年同期大幅成長 98.05%，幾乎呈現倍數躍升，下半年營運邁入高速成長期。
大銀微系統 8 月營收一舉突破 4 億元大關，寫下新里程碑，主要成長動能來自半導體與矽光子產業的爆發性需求，前 8 月累計營收達 26.7 億元，創歷年同期新高，已逼近 2025 年全年水準，年增率高達 55.75%。法人預期大銀今年全年營收將上看 40 億元。
大銀指出，旗下產品「矽光子檢測定位平台」主要供應國內半導體檢測設備大廠，該平台自第二季小量出貨後，獲得終端客戶高度滿意，8 月出現大量追加訂單，該專案交期長達 9 個月以上，能見度已一路延伸至 2027 年第二季。
此外，Stage 平台交期拉長至 3 至 4 個月，元件類交期約 3 個月，目前整體產品平均訂單能見度約半年。公司強調，下半年交貨轉趨順暢，目前仍可承接年底前交貨的訂單，歡迎客戶洽詢排單。
為緩解供不應求，大銀早已啟動總投資額約 1.5 億元的兩階段擴產計畫。第一階段於今年 6 月完成，提升定位平台約 2 成產能，效益反映在 7、8 月營收上；第二階段預計今年第四季至明年 2 月陸續完成，屆時產線分工調整後將可再額外增加 2 成產能。
paras_en: DaYin Micro Systems (4576‑TW) announced today (the 4th) its August 2026 revenue. Driven by strong demand in semiconductors and silicon photonics, monthly revenue surged to NT$427 million, a historic monthly peak, up 16.35% month‑over‑month and up 98.05% versus the same month last year – almost a doubling – signaling that the second half of the year is entering a rapid‑growth period.

August revenue broke the NT$400 million barrier, setting a new milestone. The main growth driver is the explosive demand from semiconductor testing and silicon‑photonics industries. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$2.67 billion, a record for the same period in history and close to the full‑year level of 2025, with a year‑over‑year increase of 55.75%. Analysts expect DaYin’s total revenue for the year to exceed NT$4 billion.

DaYin noted that its “silicon‑photonics testing and positioning platform” primarily supplies major domestic semiconductor testing equipment manufacturers. After a small‑scale shipment in Q2, the platform received high satisfaction from end customers, leading to a large number of additional orders in August. The project’s delivery timeline exceeds nine months, with visibility now extending through Q2 2027.

In addition, the Stage platform’s lead time has lengthened to three to four months, and component‑type items have a lead time of about three months. Overall, the average order visibility for products is roughly six months. The company emphasized that delivery is becoming smoother in the second half of the year, and it can still accept orders for delivery before year‑end; customers are welcome to inquire about scheduling.

To alleviate supply shortages, DaYin has already launched a two‑phase expansion plan with a total investment of about NT$150 million. The first phase was completed in June this year, boosting the positioning platform’s capacity by roughly 20%, a benefit already reflected in July and August revenues. The second phase is slated to be completed gradually from Q4 this year to February next year, after which re‑allocation of the production line will add another 20% capacity.

items.title: 非農太強！花旗將Fed降息預期延至2027年 下週通膨報告才是關鍵
items.title_en: Nonfarm Payrolls So Strong! Citi Pushes Fed Rate‑Cut Forecast to 2027; Next Week's Inflation Report Is Key
paras: 多家媒體報導，美國8月就業數據優於預期，顯示勞動市場仍具韌性，花旗因此取消原先對近期降息的預測，一口氣將聯準會 (Fed) 下次降息預估時間由2026年10月延後至2027年6月。
花旗先前預估，Fed將於2026年10月、12月及2027年1月分別降息1碼。調整後的基準情境則改為2027年6月、9月及12月各降息1碼。
美國8月非農就業人口增加16.2萬人，高於市場預期，失業率則維持在4.1%。此外，7月就業數據經修正後，不再呈現就業減少，也進一步反映招聘動能較原先估計強勁。
花旗經濟學家Andrew Hollenhorst 與Veronica Clark 指出，失業率保持不變，勞動參與率也明顯回升，最新數據顯示美國就業市場整體穩定。這意味Fed決策官員可望降低對就業面的憂慮，將政策焦點轉向仍具黏性的通膨。
就業報告公布後，市場迅速調整利率預期。
聯邦基金期貨顯示，Fed在9月15日至16日會議升息的機率升至約61%，高於數據公布前的52%。
不過，9月是否升息仍未定案。
由於薪資年增幅放緩，就業報告並未立即顯示薪資帶動的通膨壓力再度升高，市場接下來將聚焦下週公布的消費者物價指數 (CPI) 與生產者物價指數 (PPI)，尋找Fed政策走向的進一步線索。
Fed內部對政策方向仍存在分歧。
在7月會議上，多數官員支持維持利率不變，但有3名官員主張升息1碼。若下週消費者物價指數 (CPI) 與生產者物價指數 (PPI)高於預期，可能強化9月升息的理由；若物價壓力降溫，Fed則可能繼續按兵不動。
paras_en: Multiple media outlets reported that U.S. August employment data beat expectations, showing a still‑resilient labor market, prompting Citi to scrap its earlier near‑term rate‑cut forecast and push its estimate for the Fed's next cut from October 2026 to June 2027.

Citi had previously projected that the Fed would cut rates by one basis point in October and December 2026 and again in January 2027. The revised baseline now expects one‑basis‑point cuts in June, September and December 2027.

U.S. non‑farm payrolls rose by 162,000 in August, above market forecasts, while the unemployment rate held steady at 4.1%. In addition, July’s employment figures were revised upward, erasing the previously reported job loss and indicating hiring momentum stronger than initially thought.

Citi economists Andrew Hollenhorst and Veronica Clark noted that the unchanged unemployment rate and a clear rise in the labor‑force participation rate show the overall U.S. job market remains stable, meaning Fed policymakers can ease concerns about employment and shift focus toward still‑sticky inflation.
Following the release of the jobs report, markets quickly adjusted their rate expectations.
Federal‑funds futures now show about a 61% chance that the Fed will raise rates at its September 15‑16 meeting, up from roughly 52% before the data were released.
However, a September rate hike is not yet a certainty.

Because wage growth has slowed year‑over‑year, the jobs report did not immediately signal a resurgence of wage‑driven inflation pressure, so markets will now focus on next week’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) and Producer Price Index (PPI) releases for further clues on Fed policy direction.
There remains internal disagreement within the Fed about the policy path.

At the July meeting, most officials favored keeping rates unchanged, but three advocated a one‑basis‑point hike; if next week’s CPI and PPI come in above expectations, it could bolster the case for a September hike, whereas cooler price pressures might keep the Fed on hold.

items.title: ASIC雙雄財報亮眼股價乏力？博通、邁威爾背後兩大隱憂
items.title_en: ASIC Titans Post Strong Earnings but Share Prices Stall? Two Major Concerns Behind Broadcom and Marvell
paras: 美股財報季告一段落，全球客製化晶片(ASIC)雙雄——博通(AVGO-US)與邁威爾科技(MRVL-US)先後公布上一季業績。兩大巨頭雙雙交出優於市場預期的成績單，管理層亦進一步上調AI業務展望和財測。然而，亮眼業績似乎未能轉化為股價催化劑，短期疲弱局面仍未能擺脫。
拆解兩間公司最新財報，AI業務的增長動能無疑是最大亮點，充分反映下游雲端巨頭（CSP）對客製化晶片（ASIC）的需求依然熾熱。
博通AI半導體營收飆升2.2倍 首提供2028財年指引
截至2026財年第三季，博通營收和經調整後每股盈餘(EPS)分別為295.9億美元和3.32美元，均優於市場預期。其中，AI半導體營收達到167億美元，年增2.2倍；XPU出貨量年增超過3.5倍，佔AI半導體營收超過七成。
公司在第三季已陸續出貨Google新一代TPU和OpenAI首代Jalapeño客製化晶片，而Meta客製化晶片MTIA預計在第四季開始量產。
博通管理層對AI業務發展相當樂觀，強調雲端大客戶對下一代AI網路架構升級及客製化晶片的需求毫無放緩跡象。按目前預計2026財年AI營收580億美元的基礎上，2027財年和2028財年AI營收指引分別為1,150億美元和2,300億美元，意味未來兩個財年AI營收將維持每年翻倍的增長速度。
至於2026財年第四季整體營收指引為348億美元，略低於市場預期的350億美元。
邁威爾資料中心業務增長強勁 上調財年營收指引
邁威爾同樣交出一份由AI驅動的成績單。2027財年第二季營收年增37%，達到27.39億美元；經調整後每股盈餘為0.94美元，兩項數字均超過市場預期。
核心資料中心業務營收年增46%至21.7億美元，佔營收比重接近八成，增長主要來自光連接和客製化晶片。Non-GAAP毛利率為58.9%，低於去年同期，主要歸因於客製化晶片業務快速增長，產品組合有所改變。
邁威爾管理層同樣上調營收指引，預計2027和2028財年營收分別上調至120億和180億美元。不過，公司維持客製化晶片業務增速指引，預計2028財年營收將翻倍。
AI產業發展重心正從模型訓練轉向大規模推理應用。在這個轉折點上，客製化晶片憑藉其獨特優勢，被視為下一代AI算力的關鍵。在處理大規模、重複性的推理任務時，客製化晶片能針對特定演算法進行深度優化，能效比和單位運算成本（TCO）顯著優於通用GPU。
對亞馬遜 (AMZN-US)、Google (GOOG-US)、Google (GOOGL-US)、微軟 (MSFT-US) 等雲端服務巨頭而言，自研ASIC是建立競爭優勢的關鍵。不僅能降低對昂貴且供應受限的輝達 (NVDA-US) GPU依賴、確保算力供應，更能優化成本結構，提升雲端業務盈利能力。
此外，客製化晶片可以排除不必要的通用功能，將電力預算集中於特定工作負載的運算上。隨著AI機架密度提高，能效比的重要性也日益提升。
據市場研究公司Global Market Research於8月發布的報告，預計全球客製化晶片市場規模將從2026年的438億美元，增長至2035年的3,083億美元，2026至2035年的複合年增長率為24.2%。
競爭格局方面，博通和邁威爾目前仍維持雙寡占，合計佔全球客製化晶片市場近六成。
兩大企業深度綁定科技巨頭
客製化晶片並非標準化的通用產品，其最大的商業價值在於與終端超大規模雲端服務商（Hyperscalers）建立深度合作關係。
細看兩間公司的客製化晶片業務客戶名單，基本上已涵蓋全球市值最高、資本支出最龐大的科技巨頭。
博通在客製化晶片領域深耕多年，核心客戶包括Alphabet，為目前最核心、合作時間最長且出貨量最大的合作夥伴。其客製化晶片客戶基礎也逐漸多元化，包括Meta Platforms (META-US)、ByteDance、Anthropic和OpenAI等。
管理層預計，到2027年Anthropic將取代Alphabet成為其最大的客製化晶片客戶，OpenAI則緊隨其後，躍升為第二大客戶。
邁威爾方面，其客製化晶片最大客戶為亞馬遜，旗下自研AI訓練晶片Trainium與推理晶片Inferentia，邁威爾均扮演極為關鍵的客製化合作角色。
剛過去的8月份，邁威爾與Google宣布擴大客製化晶片長期合作，並獲納入TPU生態系統。不過，管理層透露，來自Google的重大財務貢獻最快要等到2029年才會顯現。
股價財報後乏力 兩大潛在因素浮現
兩間客製化晶片巨頭的基本面與產業前景無可挑剔，除了季業績交足功課外，也都積極開拓新客戶，以避免過度依賴單一核心客戶。
以博通為例，有市場分析認為股價財報後走軟，源於2026財年第四季指引低於預期。然而，下季度營收指引與市場預期僅相差些微，反而2028財年營收指引給予市場相當正面的訊號，單純歸咎於單一季度並不合理。
富途證券高級分析師何啟俊認為，股價乏力可能來自兩個因素。首先，今年以來環球資本市場對AI題材的追捧如火如荼，一眾站在算力最前沿的晶片巨頭，股價早已累積相當龐大的漲幅，估值亦被推升至歷史相對高位。
在極度樂觀的氛圍下，市場對兩家公司的預期值大幅拉高。儘管最新財報數字與官方指引雙雙超越市場預期，但在不少投資者眼中，潛在利好早已反映在現有股價之中。換言之，業績只是兌現此前的預期，而非帶來超預期的驚喜。要推動估值在現有水準進一步向上重估，阻力顯然不小。
其次，來自中長期的產業鏈格局潛在變化。面對客製化晶片需求激增，雲端巨頭出於供應鏈安全與供貨穩定的考量，開始有意開拓更多供應商，避免過度依賴少數合作夥伴。
龐大的客製化晶片市場也吸引更多具備實力的晶片設計與IP服務商，例如聯發科、世芯、創意電子等，加速切入這條賽道，試圖從中分一杯羹。
隨著賽道競爭日趨白熱化，市場開始擔憂博通與邁威爾目前的超高市占率，未來可能遭到部分侵蝕。更關鍵的是，供應商選擇增加後，兩大客製化晶片巨頭未來的議價能力與利潤空間可能面臨壓力。
綜合而言，客製化晶片雙雄財報後股價整固，並非基本面或產業前景出現根本性變化，回調更多是股價快速上漲後的健康調整，而非AI周期的終結。中長線而言，AI算力架構專用化的結構性趨勢並未改變，但投資人仍需留意其他來勢洶洶的競爭者，能否挑戰兩大客製化晶片巨頭的市場地位。現階段的整理，反而可能為中長線投資提供分段吸納機會。
paras_en: The U.S. earnings season has wrapped up, and the two global ASIC powerhouses—Broadcom (AVGO-US) and Marvell Technology (MRVL-US)—have each released their latest quarterly results. Both giants delivered performance that beat market expectations, and management further raised its AI business outlook and financial forecasts. Yet the impressive results have not translated into a stock catalyst, and short‑term weakness persists.

Breaking down the two companies' newest reports, the growth momentum of their AI businesses is clearly the biggest highlight, reflecting the continued hot demand for custom ASICs from downstream cloud service providers (CSPs).
Broadcom AI semiconductor revenue surges 2.2‑fold, first time providing FY2028 guidance

As of Q3 FY2026, Broadcom posted revenue of $29.59 billion and adjusted EPS of $3.32, both ahead of expectations. AI semiconductor revenue reached $16.7 billion, up 2.2 times year‑over‑year; XPU shipments grew more than 3.5 times year‑over‑year and accounted for over 70 % of AI semiconductor revenue.
In the third quarter the company began shipping Google’s next‑generation TPU and OpenAI’s first custom chip, Jalapeño, while Meta’s custom chip MTIA is slated to start volume production in Q4.

Broadcom’s management is very optimistic about AI, emphasizing that cloud megaclients show no sign of slowing their demand for next‑generation AI network upgrades and custom chips. Based on the current FY2026 AI revenue forecast of $58 billion, the company projects FY2027 and FY2028 AI revenues of $115 billion and $230 billion respectively, implying a year‑over‑year doubling pace for the next two fiscal years.
For FY2026 Q4, Broadcom’s overall revenue guidance is $34.8 billion, slightly below the market’s $35 billion expectation.
Marvell’s data‑center business shows strong growth, prompting an upward revision of its fiscal‑year revenue guidance
Marvell also delivered an AI‑driven results card. For Q2 FY2027, revenue grew 37 % year‑over‑year to $2.739 billion; adjusted EPS was $0.94, both beating market forecasts.

Core data‑center revenue rose 46 % year‑over‑year to $2.17 billion, making up nearly 80 % of total revenue, driven mainly by optical interconnects and custom chips. Non‑GAAP gross margin fell to 58.9 % from a year earlier, primarily due to the rapid expansion of the custom‑chip business and a shift in product mix.

Marvell’s management also raised its revenue outlook, now expecting FY2027 and FY2028 revenues of $12 billion and $18 billion respectively. However, the company kept its guidance for the growth rate of the custom‑chip segment, forecasting that FY2028 revenue will double.

The AI industry’s focus is shifting from model training to large‑scale inference applications. At this inflection point, custom ASICs, with their unique advantages, are seen as the key to next‑generation AI compute. For massive, repetitive inference workloads, custom chips can be deeply optimized for specific algorithms, delivering far better energy efficiency and lower total cost of ownership than general‑purpose GPUs.

For cloud giants such as Amazon (AMZN‑US), Google (GOOG‑US/GOOGL‑US), and Microsoft (MSFT‑US), developing in‑house ASICs is crucial for competitive advantage. It reduces reliance on expensive, supply‑constrained NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) GPUs, secures compute supply, and optimizes cost structures, thereby boosting cloud profitability.

In addition, custom chips can strip away unnecessary general‑purpose functions, concentrating power budgets on the specific workloads they run. As AI rack density rises, energy‑efficiency becomes increasingly important.

According to a report released by Global Market Research in August, the global custom‑chip market is projected to grow from $43.8 billion in 2026 to $308.3 billion by 2035, representing a compound annual growth rate of 24.2 % over the period.
In terms of competition, Broadcom and Marvell still dominate a duopoly, together holding close to 60 % of the worldwide custom‑chip market.
The two firms are deeply tied to technology giants
Custom ASICs are not standardized off‑the‑shelf products; their greatest commercial value lies in forging deep partnerships with hyperscale cloud service providers.
A closer look at the customer lists of both companies shows that they already cover the world’s highest‑valued and most capital‑intensive tech giants.

Broadcom has been entrenched in the custom‑chip space for years, with Alphabet as its core, longest‑standing, and largest‑volume partner. Its customer base is diversifying to include Meta Platforms (META‑US), ByteDance, Anthropic and OpenAI, among others.
Management expects Anthropic to overtake Alphabet as Broadcom’s biggest custom‑chip customer by 2027, with OpenAI moving into second place shortly thereafter.
Marvell’s biggest custom‑chip customer is Amazon, whose in‑house AI training chip Trainium and inference chip Inferentia rely heavily on Marvell’s custom‑chip expertise.

In August, Marvell announced an expanded long‑term custom‑chip partnership with Google, integrating its technology into the TPU ecosystem. However, management disclosed that the significant financial contribution from Google will not materialize until as early as 2029.
Share‑price weakness after earnings: two potential underlying factors emerge
Both ASIC giants have flawless fundamentals and industry outlooks; beyond delivering solid quarterly results, they are actively courting new customers to avoid over‑reliance on a single core client.

Take Broadcom as an example: some analysts attribute its post‑earnings share‑price dip to the FY2026 Q4 guidance falling short of expectations. Yet the next‑quarter revenue outlook is only marginally below market forecasts, while the FY2028 revenue guidance sends a very positive signal, making it unreasonable to blame a single quarter.

Futu Securities senior analyst He Qijun believes the share‑price lag may stem from two factors. First, since the start of the year, global capital markets have been feverishly chasing AI themes, and chip makers at the forefront of compute have already seen substantial price appreciation, pushing valuations to historically high levels.

In such an overly optimistic environment, market expectations for the two companies have been driven up dramatically. Even though the latest earnings and guidance both beat expectations, many investors feel that the potential upside was already priced in. In other words, the results merely confirm prior expectations rather than delivering a surprise. Pushing valuations higher from the current level faces significant resistance.

Second, there are medium‑ to long‑term shifts in the industry‑chain landscape. With surging demand for custom ASICs, cloud giants are increasingly looking to diversify their supplier base for supply‑chain security and stability, aiming to avoid over‑dependence on a few partners.

The massive custom‑chip market is also attracting more capable chip‑design and IP service firms, such as MediaTek, SiFive and Creative Electronics, which are accelerating entry into the space to claim a slice of the pie.

As competition intensifies, the market worries that Broadcom’s and Marvell’s currently lofty market shares could be eroded. More importantly, with a broader supplier pool, the bargaining power and profit margins of the two ASIC leaders may come under pressure.

Overall, the post‑earnings share‑price consolidation of the custom‑chip duopoly does not reflect a fundamental change in fundamentals or industry outlook. The pull‑back is more a healthy correction after a rapid price run‑up rather than the end of the AI cycle. In the medium to long term, the structural trend toward specialized AI compute remains intact, but investors should watch emerging competitors that could challenge the dominance of the two ASIC giants. The current consolidation may actually present a phased buying opportunity for long‑term investors.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲周線仍跌 就業數據推升Fed升息預期
items.title_en: New York FX: Dollar Rises but Weekly Trend Still Down as Jobs Data Boosts Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations
paras: 美元周五(4日)上漲，美國8月就業報告遠優於預期，推動交易員提高對聯準會(Fed)本月稍晚升息的預期，但受周四美國公債殖利率下滑及日元大幅升值帶動，美元本周仍收跌。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.3%，報99.18。本周下跌約0.5%。
外匯市場參與者將目光集中在美國非農就業報告。根據美國勞工統計局(BLS)，8月新增就業16.2萬人，幾乎是市場預期5.5萬人的3倍。失業率維持在4.1%不變。
同時，6月與7月的非農就業人數合計較先前公布數字上修5.5萬人。
這份數據公布之際，聯準會正面臨複雜的政策環境，市場也密切關注利率走向。聯準會偏好的通膨指標——個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數——已連續65個月高於2%的長期目標，也因此導致聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)內部對未來貨幣政策走向出現分歧。
就業市場保持韌性，加上通膨持續居高不下，顯示經濟可能面臨過熱及價格壓力。在這種情況下，央行通常會考慮收緊貨幣政策，因此交易員進一步押注聯準會本月稍晚升息。
美國總統川普則大力稱讚這份就業報告，卻反過來要求聯準會降息，並威脅若其他國家持續對美國保持貿易順差，美國將停止與這些國家進行貿易。
根據CME的FedWatch工具，8月就業數據公布後，市場預期FOMC在9月16日升息25個基點的機率，由約52%升至約58%。
美國政府公債拋售也重新升溫，尤其是對即將到來的政策緊縮較為敏感的短天期債券。美國2年期公債殖利率上升4.5個基點至4.379%，10年期公債殖利率則上升1.8個基點至4.780%。
Interactive Brokers資深經濟學家José Torres表示，「今天早上的非農就業數據強勁到讓殖利率飆升，但川普總統隨後救了美國公債。」
他表示，5個月來最強勁的就業增長提高了未來12天內升息的可能性，使對貨幣政策敏感的2年期公債殖利率升至19個月高點。不過，川普在就業數據公布數小時後發表的評論，使美國公債跌幅收斂，帶動各期限公債殖利率逐漸接近持平。
Torres補充，川普的言論雖然威脅聯準會的獨立性，理論上對美元不利，但經濟成長前景改善正在抵銷這項負面影響，因此美元當天仍走升，只是已遠離盤中高點。
日元大漲後回落
本周表現最亮眼貨幣當屬日元，不過日元週五走弱。
日元在前一交易日暴漲1.9%，升至155.30兌1美元的1個月高點，引發市場廣泛猜測日本政府是否出手干預外匯市場。
儘管目前沒有官方確認日本當局進行干預，日元本周仍上漲2.5%，創下7月底以來最強勁單周表現。
日元近期漲勢主要受到市場押注日本銀行(BoJ)總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)及政策委員會將在9月17日至18日的會議上升息25個基點，並釋放訊號顯示2027年將持續推動貨幣政策正常化。
其他貨幣方面，加幣走弱，美元兌加幣上漲0.3%至1.3830。
加拿大政府稍早公布數據顯示，該國8月就業市場大幅轉弱，就業人數減少4.17萬人。夏季初期的強勁招聘潮已經消退，加上美國新關稅帶來的不確定性升高，企業面臨更大壓力。市場原本預期8月就業人數將增加1.5萬人，而8月的數據也較7月增加7.51萬人的表現出現明顯反轉。
歐元本周上漲0.2%，市場正等待歐洲央行(ECB)9月10日公布利率決策。市場目前一致預期，歐洲央行將升息25個基點。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Friday (the 4th), as the U.S. August jobs report far exceeded expectations, prompting traders to raise expectations that the Fed will hike rates later this month, but the dollar still ended the week lower after Thursday’s drop in U.S. Treasury yields and a sharp appreciation of the yen.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, was up 0.3% at 99.18, down about 0.5% for the week.

Forex market participants focused on the U.S. non‑farm payroll report. According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics, August added 162,000 jobs, almost three times the market’s forecast of 55,000. The unemployment rate held steady at 4.1%.
At the same time, the combined non‑farm payroll numbers for June and July were revised upward by 55,000 from previously published figures.

The data were released as the Fed faces a complex policy environment, and markets are watching the direction of interest rates closely. The Fed‑preferred inflation gauge – the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index – has been above the 2% long‑term target for 65 consecutive months, creating divisions within the FOMC about future monetary policy.

A resilient labour market together with persistently high inflation suggests the economy may be overheating and facing price pressures. In such a scenario, central banks typically consider tightening policy, so traders further bet that the Fed will raise rates later this month.

U.S. President Donald Trump praised the jobs report but paradoxically called for a Fed rate cut and warned that if other countries continue to run trade surpluses with the United States, America will cease trade with those nations.

According to CME’s FedWatch tool, after the August jobs data were released, the market’s probability that the FOMC will raise rates by 25 basis points on September 16 rose from about 52% to roughly 58%.

U.S. government bond selling also heated up, especially in short‑term securities that are most sensitive to upcoming policy tightening. The 2‑year Treasury yield rose 4.5 basis points to 4.379%, while the 10‑year yield climbed 1.8 basis points to 4.780%.
Senior economist José Torres of Interactive Brokers said, “The strong non‑farm payroll data this morning sent yields soaring, but President Trump then rescued U.S. Treasuries.”

He added that the strongest job growth in five months boosted the odds of a rate hike within the next 12 days, pushing the 2‑year yield to a 19‑month high. However, Trump’s comments a few hours after the data release narrowed the Treasury sell‑off, causing yields across maturities to move back toward flat.

Torres noted that while Trump’s remarks threaten the Fed’s independence and are theoretically bearish for the dollar, improving growth prospects are offsetting that negative impact, so the dollar still rose that day, albeit well below its intraday peak.
Yen spikes then retreats
The best‑performing currency this week was the yen, although it weakened on Friday.
The yen surged 1.9% the previous trading day to a one‑month high of ¥155.30 per dollar, sparking widespread speculation that the Japanese government might intervene in the FX market.
Even without official confirmation of intervention, the yen still rose 2.5% this week, marking its strongest weekly performance since the end of July.

The recent yen rally is mainly driven by market bets that Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda and the policy board will raise rates by 25 basis points at their September 17‑18 meeting and signal that monetary‑policy normalisation will continue through 2027.
Among other currencies, the Canadian dollar weakened, with USD/CAD up 0.3% at 1.3830.

Canada’s government earlier released data showing a sharp slowdown in August’s labour market, with employment falling by 41,700 jobs. The strong hiring surge that characterised early summer has faded, and heightened uncertainty from new U.S. tariffs is adding pressure on firms. The market had expected August employment to rise by 15,000, and the actual figure also reversed the July gain of 75,100 jobs.
The euro rose 0.2% this week as markets await the European Central Bank’s rate decision on September 10. Consensus now points to a 25‑basis‑point hike by the ECB.
